The src tree is that commit with src/libs and src/drivers removed and
with only lv_font.c, lv_font_fmt_txt.c, lv_font_montserrat_14.c, and
lv_binfont_loader.c kept under src/font. Those extras are not used.
The port configuration is port/quotaos/lv_conf.h.
